newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish Nov industrial output rises 5.5 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Turkish Nov industrial output rises 5.5 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Turkey's industrial output rose by 5.5 percent in November from a year earlier, compared with a 15.5 percent growth in October, the State Institute of Statistics (SIS) said on Tuesday.
The industrial production growth was up 10.9 percent in November 1995, the SIS said.

It said the manufacturing sector grew by 5.3 percent year-on-year in November, compared with 11.3 percent in November 1995. The mining sector shrunk by 13.1 percent in November against 7.2 percent growth in the same 1995 month.
